messages.subject: Planned maintenance: DMS unavailable Sat 8 March 06:00-10:00
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The document management system (NetDocuments) will be unavailable this Saturday 8 March between 06:00 and 10:00 for scheduled maintenance. Please save and close any documents beforehand. Email is unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
